opb. Prophylactic treatment with aspirin should be advised throughout the pregnancy.
opc. Prophylaxis with acenocoumarol should be advised throughout the pregnancy.
opd. Since the thrombophilia study was negative, only prophylaxis of venous thrombosis with compression stockings for lower limbs is required.
